title: Hyperbound Review 2026: Is Hyperbound Worth It?
summary: A Hyperbound review built from its own product pages: AI roleplay, Perform call scoring, security, pricing, who it fits, and a two-week pilot to test it.
body_markdown:
Area


What Hyperbound's pages say (checked October 2026)


What to test yourself


AI roleplay


Buyer simulations built from "your product, ICP, and messaging"; cold calls, discovery, objections and demos


Realism on your hardest objection, judged by two managers


Bot building


Bots from a LinkedIn profile or an uploaded transcript; 3 to 5 minutes of research per bot


Time to a scenario your managers approve, beyond the first draft


Scoring


Custom scorecards, "concept-based" scoring, feedback with transcript citations


Agreement between the tool and your managers on the same sessions


Real calls


Perform scores real calls, coaches deals, and includes a native recorder or connects yours


Whether scores on real calls match your managers' grades


Enterprise


SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, enterprise SSO, SIEM


Request the documents from the security trust center


Pricing


Free plan; Practice and Perform per user, no published prices


A written first-year total with add-ons
